title: Split the focus_owner Dart files under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring main.dart (538), policy.dart (272), enforcement_status_card.dart (268), widget_test.dart (351) and policy_test.dart (253) under the cap, using Dart's part/part of where private declarations cross the seam.
acceptance_criteria: flutter test reports exactly 94 passing tests, the same as before the split.
flutter analyze reports no issues at all: no errors, no warnings, no infos.
Library-private declarations that cross a seam use part/part of rather than import. Dart privates are library-scoped, so a plain import cannot see them and the analyzer rejects it outright.
No test is deleted, skipped or weakened; whole groups move verbatim.
A split that separates a group from the testWidgets() calls that implicitly initialised the binding must add TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() explicitly to BOTH halves.
focus_owner/analysis_options.yaml carries a pre-existing uncommitted change made by someone else and must NOT be staged.
out_of_scope: The Kotlin sources under android/, which are a separate commit.
verifier: flutter test (expects 94 passed), flutter analyze (expects 'No issues found!'), and check_file_length.sh over focus_owner.
